attackers_goals: Create a new scheduled task or alter an existing one to gain persistence in the system or to gain higher privileges.
description: Attackers may create or alter scheduled task parameters to gain higher privileges or persistence on the system.
investigative_actions: Examine the PowerShell command to identify suspicious scheduled task creation or modification. Inspect the system for suspicious activity that is triggered by a scheduled task.
name: Uncommon PowerShell commands used to create or alter scheduled task parameters
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
